gazebo_comparison.method: Recomputed Gazebo CSV pairs using the same repeatability function as Isaac, verified saved metrics and source run/CSV hashes, compared common scored trial/instance rows, and compared all five stored RGB samples per trial offline.
limits: Gazebo runs were recorded November 3–4 at source revisions 4e22a20, 6d7817c and 8321456 and later imported into restart11; latest Isaac pairs were recorded November 20–21 using P0 plus committed render/readiness changes.

Five edge scenarios were replaced/repositioned; 83 shared scene definitions are unchanged. This is a historical comparison with different models, revisions and session layouts, not a controlled backend-only A/B.
New Isaac ran one condition first in each fresh session; Gazebo conditions came from multi-condition sessions.
Coverage differs. Common-scored subsets preserve the projective/Euclidean conclusions, including the Isaac box/monocular Euclidean outlier.
Old Gazebo box/monocular r1 has five unmeasured sampled startup batches; its full-window repeatability CSVs are retained, while that first-trial replay population is inconclusive.
Pixel comparisons cover only the five stored batches at each window start; they do not establish all-frame image identity.
Reported differences measure repeatability, not distance accuracy or a population variance from more than two repetitions.

gazebo_comparison_means.definition: Mean absolute difference between repeat-1 and repeat-2 trial_estimate_m, paired by trial_id and instance_index; only finite numeric pairs contribute. This is not mean error against ground truth.

first_pair_provenance.adaptation: Main render/readiness changes were committed before handoff execution; identical code delta derived from merge-base to current main HEAD, including four formerly untracked Python files.
